hrīṁ
------------------------------------------
Mantras recommended for जप and meditation usually include a बीज (or बीजमन्त्र) (seed-letter) which contains in itself the form and the power of the deity of the मन्त्र. ‘Hrīṁ’ is one of the well-known bījas assigned to the goddess षोडशी, an aspect of पार्वती.
It is also one of the niyamas prescribed by लययोग. (See LAYAYOGA for details.) It is interpreted as being ashamed (hrī = sense of shame) of all such undesirable actions which are opposed to योग as described by the scriptures.
See also BĪJAMANTRA.
